readings: For each equipment reference in scanenvironment, calculate its average nonmissing humepct. Calculate the reference average as the mean of those per-equipment averages, and keep only equipment whose average exceeds it. For each kept equipment reference, show its average humidity, the amount by which it exceeds the reference average, and the absolute difference between its average and the mean of the kept equipment's per-equipment averages. Return no rows if either reference average is missing. Sort by the absolute difference descending, with missing values last. Return at most 10 rows, dropping any additional rows tied at the cutoff arbitrarily.

For each equipment reference in scanenvironment, calculate its average nonmissing humepct. Calculate the reference average as the mean of those per-equipment averages, and keep only equipment whose average exceeds it. For each kept equipment reference, show its average humidity, the amount by which it exceeds the reference average, and the absolute difference between its average and the mean of all nonmissing humidity readings belonging to kept equipment, pooling those readings across equipment. Return no rows if either reference average is missing. Sort by the absolute difference descending, with missing values last. Return at most 10 rows, dropping any additional rows tied at the cutoff arbitrarily.
queries:
WITH equipment_averages AS (
    SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity
    FROM scanenvironment
    GROUP BY equipref
),
reference_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS avg_humidity
    FROM equipment_averages
),
kept_equipment AS (
    SELECT e.equipref, e.avg_humidity
    FROM equipment_averages AS e
    CROSS JOIN reference_average AS r
    WHERE e.avg_humidity > r.avg_humidity
),
kept_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS avg_humidity
    FROM kept_equipment
)
SELECT
    k.equipref,
    k.avg_humidity,
    k.avg_humidity - r.avg_humidity AS excess_humidity,
    ABS(k.avg_humidity - a.avg_humidity) AS absolute_difference
FROM kept_equipment AS k
CROSS JOIN reference_average AS r
CROSS JOIN kept_average AS a
WHERE r.avg_humidity IS NOT NULL
  AND a.avg_humidity IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY absolute_difference IS NULL, absolute_difference DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH equipment_averages AS (
    SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity
    FROM scanenvironment
    GROUP BY equipref
),
reference_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS value
    FROM equipment_averages
),
kept AS (
    SELECT ea.equipref, ea.avg_humidity
    FROM equipment_averages AS ea
    CROSS JOIN reference_average AS ra
    WHERE ea.avg_humidity > ra.value
),
pooled_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(se.humepct) AS value
    FROM scanenvironment AS se
    JOIN kept AS k ON k.equipref = se.equipref
)
SELECT
    k.equipref,
    k.avg_humidity,
    k.avg_humidity - ra.value AS amount_above_reference,
    ABS(k.avg_humidity - pa.value) AS absolute_difference
FROM kept AS k
CROSS JOIN reference_average AS ra
CROSS JOIN pooled_average AS pa
WHERE ra.value IS NOT NULL
  AND pa.value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY absolute_difference IS NULL, absolute_difference DESC
LIMIT 10;
